name: Vercel
how_to_set: Hobby plan: usage limits are hard; projects pause when exceeded.
Pro: Team Settings > Billing > Spend Management: set the amount and turn on "Pause all production deployments", then confirm.
Add SMS or email notifications at 50/75/100%.
kill_switch: Spend Management pauses production deployments for every project in the team (visitors get 503 DEPLOYMENT_PAUSED); resume each project by hand.
traps: Pause is opt-in; without it Spend Management only notifies
Raising the limit does not resume paused projects
Function duration and image optimisation drive overage
AI Gateway and v0 usage may continue after the pause
unverified: AI Gateway and v0 usage continuing after the pause is from a third-party report
